{{Quote|Squad One, prepare to charge!|Lok Durd|<ref name="Defenders of Peace">{{TCW|Defenders of Peace}}</ref>}}
'''Squad One''' was a squad of forty-eight [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s and eight [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 battle droids]] in the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] that were under the command of the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lok Durd/Legends|Lok Durd]]. They accompanied Durd to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]] to test the Neimoidian's new artillery weapon, the [[Defoliator/Legends|defoliator]], which when detonated could destroy all organic matter in the weapon's blast radius but leave mechanical objects, like the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], unharmed. Soon after arriving at the planet and setting up the base camp, Durd carried out a successful first test of the defoliator using a pair of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s, which [[Squad/Legends|Squad]] 1 witnessed. Lok then took Squad 1, along with at least two other squads, to test the defoliator on the planet's indigenous [[Lurmen/Legends|Lurmen]] colony.

However, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]], [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Bly/Legends|Bly]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]], who had crash landed on the planet earlier, found out what Lok was planning against the peaceful Lurmen village, and had set out to [[Defense of Maridun/Legends|stop him]]. When the droids arrived at the colony, the Jedi enveloped the colony with a [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] using a pair of [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generators]] they had stolen from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist's]] base camp. The defoliator could not penetrate the deflector shield, so Lok ordered Squad 1 to attack the colony, destroy the Jedi, and take down the shield generators. The first squad charged the colony, but the three [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and their two [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] were able to easily defeat the battle droids, the Jedi cutting down most of the droids with their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]]. After defeating Durd's forces, the Jedi were able to capture the Neimoidian and destroy the defoliator.
